lines.line: Zeythar, nobody told me adulthood would be this expensive.
lines.delivery: Exasperated and a little dramatic, casual.

lines.line: You were informed. You simply ignored the terms and conditions.
lines.delivery: Deadpan and dry, flat monotone, unhurried, no sing-song.

lines.line: It does. You are now free to pay all your bills yourself.
lines.delivery: Dry deadpan, matter-of-fact, a tiny beat after 'It does'.
Flat and fed up, half joking.

lines.line: Unfortunately, your free trial ended at eighteen.
lines.delivery: Completely deadpan and final, flat monotone, slow.
